title: Turtle eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='46' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#2e7d32'/>

  <path d='M16 64 Q10 68 14 60 Z' fill='#7cb342'/>
